body:
## Outcome and dependencies

Execute the small, frozen #63 evaluation through the authorized-PR native profile and independently assess what the **real-provider workflow actually delivers**. Produce an auditable outcome-quality report for #62, including errors and noncompletion, rather than a claim inferred from green unit tests or opened PRs.

**Parent:** #62. **Depends on:** #63's current frozen protocol, [`p5-native-pr-v2`](https://github.com/faviann/broodling/blob/1d581717509de182410c3ab2f54d3f65768d8d7f/evaluation/p5/v2/protocol.md), and #64's successful live boundary evidence on the compatible recorded product/dependency/target baseline. Before each dispatch, current infrastructure, authorization and remaining run/spend limits must still be valid and bound to the v2 freeze commit. Issue closure alone is not sufficient evidence of readiness. If #64 cannot establish delivery, record this campaign as blocked/not run for final review; do not manufacture quality evidence through a different execution path.

## Authority and source basis

Follow [docs/governing/current.md](https://github.com/faviann/broodling/blob/main/docs/governing/current.md), #62, and the frozen #63 protocol under that authority, including the prospective v2 amendment made before any live result, then current production code and [tests/README.md](https://github.com/faviann/broodling/blob/main/tests/README.md). Backlog inspection used `b901367b339c3ca715fa51ad91646b499a8fa068`.

[submission.py](https://github.com/faviann/broodling/blob/b901367b339c3ca715fa51ad91646b499a8fa068/broodling/submission.py) passes the frozen Contract and entitled instructions to the standard workflow. [disposition.py](https://github.com/faviann/broodling/blob/b901367b339c3ca715fa51ad91646b499a8fa068/broodling/disposition.py) validates native success, receipt identity and current authority; it does not independently establish task correctness. The [native integration design](https://github.com/faviann/broodling/blob/b901367b339c3ca715fa51ad91646b499a8fa068/docs/implementation/zeroshot-native-integration.md) assigns implementation, review and repair to Zeroshot. Independent judging here is an evaluation activity, not another product acceptance hop.

## Work and completion criteria

- Run only the frozen tasks, supported runtime selection and bounded repetitions approved in `p5-native-pr-v2`, including valid change controls and meaningful failure opportunities. Use existing Broodling admission/submission/disposition entrypoints and the standard Zeroshot workflow. Implementation, review and any repair reached in a run counted as real-provider evidence must use real providers. Do not script semantic responses, fabricate findings/receipts, alter frozen authority mid-run or force a custom repair route. No provider substitution or seeded diagnostic campaign is authorized by v2.
- Independently check and review each exact accepted `headRevision` against its original entitled criteria and B1. Retain the checked revision/material and check outputs; neither the PR's mutable latest tip nor provider self-report is sufficient. Preserve native result, Broodling disposition and evaluator judgment as separate facts, including a structurally valid successful PR whose content fails criteria. For rejected/incomplete runs retain the actual outcome and use the frozen rules to distinguish legitimate refusal, unjustified rejection/noncompletion, infrastructure/capability problems and indeterminate cases. Do not invent a stable accepted revision for a run that has none.
- Retain every started run, not just successes. Report observed correct outcomes, false acceptance and unjustified rejection/noncompletion with explicit counts and denominators; separately report infrastructure failures, capability gaps, stopped/incomplete trials and uncertain judgments. Treat ratios as **descriptive observations, not reliability estimates or acceptance percentages**. Report correction effectiveness, regressions/churn and cost/latency only where the supported observations allow it. Missing repair traces or billing data remain unavailable, not invented or grounds to add a runtime observer. An opened PR is not proof of passing CI, a merge, or general reliability.
- Apply the predeclared v2 claim-level decision rules, handling of reruns, budget stops and protocol deviations. R01 counts only once and only if it meets the real-provider/independent-judging conditions. A false acceptance, a second unjustified noncompletion, or two non-correct repetitions of one task makes the positive v2 gate impossible and stops further confirmatory dispatch. Baseline or measurement changes require a recorded prospective amendment and separate evidence identity; do not pool incompatible runs or erase failures. Keep independent trial allocation compatible with one current Attempt and permanent quarantine of dispatched Attempts.

Completion is a reproducible bounded report comparing observed outcomes with the frozen criteria and **claim-level v2 evidence rules**, including honest failure/blocked conclusions and sample limitations. It need not manufacture an internal repair event or a passing quality score. A partly executed or unexecuted campaign cannot be described as a successful evaluation; record exactly which claims remain unsupported for the gate.

## Evidence to retain

Retain the frozen protocol and compatibility/preflight references; each task's entitled sources, B1, immutable Contract and effect authorization; product/dependency/provider/model/effort/target configuration; Attempt/submission-key/run IDs; complete native results/receipts and Broodling outcomes; exact checked revisions and independent commands, outputs and reviewer reasoning; per-run classification; budget/run accounting and available cost/latency/correction observations; all failures, substitutions, deviations and unexecuted cases. Keep durable sanitized records outside disposable candidate worktrees, with enough material to reproduce judging without relying on permanent remote Git-object retention. Preserve all historical evidence.

## Permitted changes and stop boundary

May add evaluation records, independent offline analysis/judging support and narrowly necessary reproduction documentation. May execute only approved tasks and effects on the disposable evaluation resources. Do not change production behavior, schemas, runtime/model/reviewer selection, workflow prompts/routing, frozen task criteria or v2 decision rules to improve measured results. Any evaluator correction must be versioned and its effect on prior judgments disclosed; it cannot silently redefine success.

Stop according to `p5-native-pr-v2`'s agreed limits, claim-level stopping rules and safety rules, on invalid authorization or an invalidated baseline, or on a blocking integration defect. Ordinary task failures remain observations under the frozen protocol, not invitations to tune or rerun until green. Record narrowly justified follow-up for actual defects instead of fixing them inside the campaign.

No custom graph/evidence worker/adjudicator/final assessor/supervisor, automatic dispatched replacement, no-effect snapshot/PR fallback, broader effects/merge, long-term custody service, new CLI/service, model/reviewer tuning campaign or historical G1–G4 requalification. Stop after the quality report; leave the independent P5 verdict to the review issue. **Planning item only at creation; not started.**
title: [P5] Run the bounded real-provider outcome-quality evaluation
